summary: Full backend + frontend QA of the Job Center → Job Sectors/Agency Browser feature (iteration 29). Backend: 12/12 pytest cases PASSED covering GET /jobs/sectors (7 seeded sectors, no virtual General Listings, sum of job_count == 19 total jobs), GET /jobs/sectors/{id} (Retail returns Cashier/Sales Assistant/Store Manager; Logistics returns Delivery Driver/Warehouse Worker/Logistics Manager; Retail and Logistics are disjoint sets; unknown sector → 404; qualified flag present on every job), player forbidden from admin sectors endpoint (403), and full admin CRUD (create + list-visibility + player-visibility + detail + update + delete + post-delete 404). Frontend: as player /job-center now shows the sector browser (all 7 sector cards found by data-testid sector-<id> with matching open-listings-<id>, X listings · Y qualify line, and Your Applications panel above). Opening a sector (Retail) shows the sector title/description banner, back-to-sectors button, sector-jobs grid with exactly the 3 correct job cards (Cashier as Current with goto-current-<id>, Sales Assistant with apply-job-<id>, Store Manager locked with reason). Back button returns to browser. Opening Logistics shows a different set (Delivery Driver, Warehouse Worker, Logistics Manager) — no overlap with Retail. Apply flow verified via fresh throwaway player: POST /jobs/{id}/apply → 200 {ok:true, resolves_in_minutes:10} and application listed as status=pending. Admin CRUD verified in UI: admin-tab-job sectors reveals 7 admin-sector-<id> cards; sector-new opens jobsector-editor; filled sector-name/sector-icon/sector-desc + 2 of 19 sector-job-cb-<jobId> checkboxes; sector-save creates it (visible in admin list AND immediately visible to player via API); sector-edit-<id> re-opens editor and update persists; sector-del-<id> uses window.confirm and shows a 'Deleted' toast. Final admin list restored to exactly the 7 seeded sectors.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin tab data-testid 'admin-tab-job sectors' contains a SPACE (auto-generated from lowercased button text 'JOB SECTORS'). Same fragility flagged in iteration_27/28 for admin-tab-city shops — recommend slugifying to admin-tab-job-sectors to prevent future selector escaping issues. Purely a testability nit; functional now.

Sector 'unassigned' virtual fallback code path exists in /jobs/sectors and /jobs/sectors/{id} but currently no jobs are unassigned — this is correct per seed. Suggest an admin warning banner when an unassigned/virtual sector appears in the list so admins immediately notice a data-integrity gap (nice-to-have).

meets_requirements() is invoked twice per job in list_job_sectors (once for open_count computation and effectively repeated in the detail endpoint). For 19 jobs this is negligible; if the job count grows, consider caching per-request. Not a bug.

Admin job-sectors CRUD accepts arbitrary strings for icon (no whitelist). Setting a nonexistent icon name will silently render a default icon. Consider validating against a known icon set (Briefcase/ShoppingBag/UtensilsCrossed/Truck/Building2/Wrench/Shield/Landmark).
test_credentials: admin@kaeldor.com / admin123 and player@kaeldor.com / player123 — both used and worked. Also registered a throwaway player for the clean apply-flow verification (auto-created via /auth/register + /character/create).
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest created + deleted 'TEST_QA_Sector' with 2 assigned jobs (cleaned in test). Frontend UI test created 'TEST_QA_Sector_UI' → edited to 'TEST_QA_Sector_UI_v2' → DELETED via the UI. Final admin list = 7 seeded sectors. Throwaway registered player is left in DB (harmless per iteration guidelines).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature stable. Seeded sectors (data-testid sector-<id> / admin-sector-<id>): sector_retail (Retail & Sales, 3 jobs), sector_hospitality (Food & Hospitality, 3), sector_logistics (Logistics & Transport, 3), sector_corporate (Corporate & Office, 2), sector_trades (Trades & Manual Labor, 2), sector_military (Military & Defense, 3), sector_public (Public Services, 3) — total 19 == total jobs in DB, so no virtual General Listings. Player URLs/testids: /api/jobs/sectors, /api/jobs/sectors/{id}, back-to-sectors, sector-jobs, job-card-<id>, apply-job-<id>, pending-job-<id>, goto-current-<id>. Admin URLs/testids: /api/admin/job-sectors (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE); tab 'admin-tab-job sectors' (SPACE), sector-new, jobsector-editor, sector-name, sector-icon, sector-desc, sector-jobs-picker, sector-job-cb-<jobId> (19 checkboxes), sector-save, sector-edit-<id>, sector-del-<id> (uses window.confirm). Neo (player@) is currently a Cashier in Retail so Retail always shows goto-current-cashier for that account.
rca of the issue: No bugs found — the Job Sectors feature meets all 5 review scenarios end-to-end (sector browser, sector open/detail, apply flow, admin CRUD, no unreachable jobs).
